text:
mara: quick thread 1: migration for notify.owner. current state: freeform tag -> ambiguous paging. we need a migration UX + runtime semantics.

jess: totally. i'd like the migration to be a two-step flow: suggestion + confirm. suggestions based on tenant metadata and historical paging graph.

oli: agree but also need runtime safety. don't flip who gets paged until teams opt-in or we run a dry-run mode that records `would_page` events.

samir: implementation idea: evaluate resolved_owner during rule ingest and store `resolved_snapshot_v1` on the rule. feature flag `resolved_owner_v1` controls whether console reads that field. dry-run emits events: `notify.migration_would_page` and `notify.migration_decision` when actually enabled.

liz: for console UX: show a compact diff for each rule: old tag -> suggested owner(s) with confidence score and last 30d historical pages. allow bulk-accept with per-tenant overrides. mock will include a small preview graph.

arun: on routing: we must avoid N+1 fanout spikes. suggest a default single-primary model with optional fanout list. primary chosen by deterministic scoring: score = alpha*capacity_left + beta*recent_ack_rate - gamma*current_inflight. tie-breaker: prefer the current oncall if score within delta.

mara: good. also add a per-owner "fallback_opt_out" flag so teams can mark themselves not to be used as fallback. console should surface that when suggesting mappings.

jess: telemetry: define two events: `notify.eval` (labels: rule_id, tenant_id, input_tags, suggested_owners[], confidence) and `notify.route` (labels: decision_id, chosen_owner, fallback_used, reason_code). show examples in RFC.

samir: also emit `notify.migration_preview` when the mapping UI runs so product can compute estimated reduction in fanout/cost before commit. stores a small sample of affected tenants to keep it lightweight.

oli: quota interaction: when routing uses fallback, decrement a per-owner routed_quota counter and emit `notify.quota_charge` with amount=1 and owner_id. this lets billing/ops surface who absorbed noise.

liz: UX ask: allow editing "primary_owner" inline with a small justification field that becomes part of the audit log. require a confirmation modal for bulk edits that could increase fanout.

arun: about precompute vs render-time: precompute during ingest for speed. but include a fast re-eval endpoint `POST /eval/notify-rule` for admins to preview changes in console.

mara: migration plan suggestion: 1) compute suggestions in staging (read-only), 2) open migration UI to internal teams to accept/reject per-tenant, 3) enable edit/writeback for accepted mappings, 4) flip feature flag for resolved_owner for all.

jess: edgecases: stale tenant metadata. include a TTL and fallback heuristics if metadata missing. document in RFC.

samir: costing: add a nightly job to compute `fanout_credit` per tenant so we can surface long-lived noisy tenants to customers.

liz: mock will show small badge "migration candidate" next to rules, with a tooltip. also an export CSV for large account managers.

mara: can someone take RFC? needs: API shape, event schema, migration UI wireframes, rollout checklist. timeline: draft by end of week?

oli: i'll lead RFC and include deterministic scoring formula and safety gates.

jess: i'll author telemetry events + Prom labels.

samir: i'll add migration preview endpoint and fanout estimator.

liz: mocks and CSV export.

arun: i'll review routing semantics and quota-charging hooks.

deploy-bot: branch created: infra/rfc/primary-owner-migrate-1765499999 1 tests will run on push. :robot_face:

mara: thanks. one last thing: include an automated opt-out email to teams that become primary during migration so they can opt-out before being paged.

jess: also include a small experiment: route 1% of traffic to new primary to verify ack behavior before full switch.

oli: noted, will add canary percent and rollback metric thresholds.

mara: perfect. i'll post RFC template link in #eng-platform and pin this thread.
